{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative or neutral, especially after recent spikes.",
    "Reduce forecast overshoots by 10-15% in the immediate post-spike period.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if 30-day average of true outcomes is significantly higher than forecast, adjust forecast upward by 5-10%.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent sentiment shifts — especially when sentiment turns from negative to positive.",
    "For long-term horizons (>14 days), reduce forecast volatility by smoothing with 7-day moving average of true outcomes.",
    "When sentiment is positive and price is trending upward, add a 5-10% upward bias to forecast to capture momentum.",
    "If model consistently underestimates true outcomes in high-sentiment periods, increase forecast baseline by 3-5%."
  ]
}
